Basic ATC

تمت الموافقة على تغيير التردد

ATC clearance for the pilot to leave the current frequency, typically when no further communication is required on that frequency.

Quick answer: ATC clearance for the pilot to leave the current frequency, typically when no further communication is required on that frequency.
